tournamentEntry.shareText: Discover TournArena, the app to follow your competitions.

hero.title: Follow a competition
hero.hint: Pools, knockout brackets, schedule and live standings.

register.title: Create my account
register.lede: Create your organizer account to manage your tournaments directly from the app.
register.sentBody: A confirmation email was sent to {{email}}.
register.sentHint: Open the link inside to activate your account, then come back here to log in.
register.errorConflict: An account already exists with this email.
register.errorGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again.

login.title: Log in
login.lede: Log in to your organizer account.
login.errorVerify: Verify your email before logging in.
login.errorGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again.

list.title: My tournaments
list.errorGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again.

wizard.title: New tournament
wizard.errorGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again.

teams.title: Participating teams
teams.minHint: At least 3 teams are needed to move on to the next step.
teams.errorAdd: Couldn't add this team, please try again.
teams.errorRemove: Couldn't remove this team, please try again.

structure.title: Competition format

poolsKnockout.name: Pools then knockout
poolsKnockout.desc: Group stage, then the top teams face off in a knockout bracket.

knockoutOnly.name: Single-elimination knockout
knockoutOnly.desc: One loss and a team is out. Fast, a single winner.

league.name: League (round-robin)
league.desc: Every team plays every other team once.

structure.editOnWebHint: To change the structure, use the web admin (Structure).

calendar.title: Match schedule
calendar.lede: Automatically generate the schedule from the teams and format you chose.
calendar.noScheduleHint: No schedule to generate for this format -- a knockout bracket fills in match by match, as results come in.
calendar.editLaterHint: Exact times and venues can be adjusted later from "My tournaments".
calendar.errorGeneric: Something went wrong, please try again.

publish.paymentHint: If your free tier is exceeded, a secure Stripe payment will be offered before publishing.
publish.planActive: Annual subscription active until {{date}} — every publication of yours is free.
publish.planNone: Billed per publication based on team count. The annual subscription makes every publication of yours free.

done.title: Tournament published!
done.body: {{name}} is live and ready to receive results.
done.pendingPaymentBody: A secure payment tab has opened. Once payment is complete, your tournament will be published -- check back from My tournaments to see its status.
